meta.title: Skills Settings
meta.description: View loaded user skills in settings.

ui.description: This setting applies only to DSH.
ui.empty: No loaded skills from this source.
ui.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, description, or path
ui.error: Could not load skills. Close and reopen this settings section to try again.
ui.incomplete: Some skill sources could not be loaded. This list may be incomplete.
ui.openFolderHint: Open this skill’s folder in the file manager on the DSH host.
ui.openFolderUnavailable: Folder opening requires a desktop on the DSH host.
ui.openFolderError: Could not open the skill folder. Check the file manager on the DSH host and try again.
ui.translationAllError: Some skill descriptions could not be translated. Try again to translate only the failed items.
ui.translationNotice: Expanding a skill or translating all skills sends descriptions to the service selected in reasoning translation settings. Translate all includes both shared and DSH skills. Translations are cached using its target language.
ui.translationError: Could not translate. The original is shown. Paid services require a Session and are unavailable here.
ui.saveError: Could not save the setting. Close and reopen this section to check the saved state before trying again.
